The Advocacy Interceptor is lightweight yet ultra resilient armor that provides protection without sacrificing mobility. Mixing impact resistant fabrics with precision plating, the armor also comes with easily accessible pouches on the waist and adjustable straps to ensure an ideal fit. This system is extensively used by the Advocacy thanks to the armor's excellent comfort, quality, and protection.

ui_inventory_weight_tooltip,P:
Equipment Encumbrance & Sprint Speed Breakpoints

Total equipped mass determines your movement speed & stamina burn:

- [GREEN] 0.0 - 14.9 kg: 100% Move Speed (0% Penalty)
  Optimal mobility and maximum sprint duration.

- [YELLOW] 15.0 - 24.9 kg: ~95% Move Speed (-5% Penalty)
  Light encumbrance; minor stamina drain increase.

- [ORANGE] 25.0 - 34.9 kg: ~90% Move Speed (-10% Penalty)
  Standard combat loadout; noticeable sprint penalty.

- [RED] 35.0 - 44.9 kg: ~85% Move Speed (-15% Penalty)
  Heavy encumbrance; rapid stamina depletion.

- [CRITICAL] 45.0+ kg: ~80% Move Speed (-20% Max Penalty)
  Severe mobility penalty; quick heart rate spikes.

Note: Only equipped armor, weapons, and core magazines count towards this bar. Items stored inside your backpack inventory do not penalize movement speed.
